changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/9269-grid-summary-percent-converged.md`

- names `useColumnSummary.ts` → `packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts` — edited by this change

  > `formatSummaryLabel` in `useColumnSummary.ts` held a **hand-inlined copy of `percentDisplayValue`'s body** and then appended a **literal ASCII percent sign**:

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `90dac98fa` (merge-base with origin/main): 7 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1325 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (1898 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36048982759)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `a5b45f1584fc672ef1b2dfbd1ddef1138017ffc8`

Rendered by an isolated review subagent spawned by the `domain:ui#4` seat; its served tier was checked against its transcript stamps (all at the review tier). Adopted by this seat.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Inputs read.** PR #10348 (draft, 2 commits `450ff5176` → `a5b45f158`, 10 files, +735/−59, base ref `main`); merge-base with `origin/main` is `1dbb9933c` (the dev's stated base); `origin/main` tip `1f8ef0a89` has moved 171 files since the fork but NONE of the PR's 10 files, so the merge-base diff is the true diff. Rulings 乙 `5805782503`, director pointer `5805820461`, B `5791803339` + correction `5805294161`, claim `5819290526`, card #10221 body + 5 comments, sibling #10319 (merged `31938f01d`) and its changeset, objectstack PR #19909 (open draft, on hold). Local reads were `git show` / `git grep` / `git diff` against the fetched refs only (no working-tree tool). One read-only `node` probe was run from the scratch directory (plain `Intl.NumberFormat` readings replicating the base arm and `formatCurrency`); no gate family was re-run.

- **(a) The "no fraction on a whole amount" rule vs ruling 乙.** `formatCurrency` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) picks ONE width: `isWhole ? 0 : currency ? currencyFractionDigits(currency) : 2`. The wholeness switch is the cell's documented convention ("Salesforce convention: `$1,234.50` keeps cents; `$1,234` does not"), pinned by objectui#4033 and deliberately kept by objectui#4361 ("The wholeness switch itself is NOT retired"). Ruling 乙 item 1 says "the currency's ISO 4217 minor unit decides its display", and 乙's own premise reads the cell as "renders the ISO 4217 minor unit"; ruling B item 3/4 and card item 3 order that "the footer and the cell agree on a currency column". Judgment: aligning footer and tile to the cell by reference satisfies the card as ruled. Recorded as a finding AGAINST THE CELL, not this PR: a whole USD amount rendered `$1,234` is not the two-digit minor unit in the strict sense, and the sibling #10319's `CurrencyField` (edit widget, read-only face included) has no wholeness switch, so it shows `$1,234.00` where cell, footer and tile now show `$1,234`. Whether 乙 tolerates the wholeness switch is a question for the director, ⛔ not for this PR to answer; the PR body's A4 note declares the difference honestly.

- **(b) Before → after per face (probe, `en`, amounts 1234.5 and 1234; base arm = `scale ?? 0` with one width both bounds; after = `formatCurrency`).**
  - USD: no `scale` or `scale: 0`: `$1,235` → `$1,234.50` (whole `$1,234` unchanged); `scale: 2`: fractional unchanged, whole `$1,234.00` → `$1,234`; `scale: 4`: `$1,234.5000` → `$1,234.50`, `$1,234.0000` → `$1,234`.
  - JPY: no `scale` or `0`: unchanged (`¥1,235` / `¥1,234`, zero width by accident); `scale: 2`: `¥1,234.50` → `¥1,235`, `¥1,234.00` → `¥1,234`; `scale: 4`: `¥1,234.5000` → `¥1,235`, `¥1,234.0000` → `¥1,234`.
  - KWD: no `scale` or `0`: `KWD 1,235` → `KWD 1,234.500` (whole unchanged); `scale: 2`: `KWD 1,234.50` → `KWD 1,234.500`, `KWD 1,234.00` → `KWD 1,234`; `scale: 4`: `KWD 1,234.5000` → `KWD 1,234.500`, `KWD 1,234.0000` → `KWD 1,234`.
  - No currency resolved: no `scale` or `0`: `1,235` → `1,234.50` (whole `1,234` unchanged); `scale: 2`: whole `1,234.00` → `1,234`; `scale: 4`: `1,234.5000` → `1,234.50`, `1,234.0000` → `1,234`.
  - Footer: the currency arm is now `currency && !intlAcceptsCurrency(currency) ? value.toLocaleString(displayLocale) : formatCurrency(value, currency, displayLocale)`; `column.scale` is no longer read there. Tile: `inferredFormat` lost its currency branch; with a code resolved `tileValue = formatCurrency(amount, inferredCurrency, displayLocale)` (a non-numeric string, which `MetricWidget.formatMetricValue` passes through untouched — verified: it re-parses only strings for which `Number(value)` is finite); with no code, `tileFormat = Number.isInteger(amount) ? '0,0' : '0,0.00'`, which `MetricWidget` renders with min = max = pattern width and grouping, i.e. `1,234` / `1,234.50`, byte-equal to the cell's `formatNumber(value, 0 | 2)`. An authored `format` short-circuits both (control case pinned). A stale `scale` is inert on every currency path; `precision` is read on none.
  - Untouched, as ruling B retires `scale` from currency ONLY: footer percent arm still `column?.scale ?? 0` → `formatPercent`; tile percent `'0,0%'` and number/integer `'0,0'`; the percent-of-rows, avg and plain arms; designer keeps `Scale` on `number` and `percent`.
  - Malformed code (the #9294 fixture `'EU'`): `intlAcceptsCurrency` returns false and the footer keeps `value.toLocaleString(displayLocale)`, byte-equal to base's catch. A well-formed but unknown code (`ZZZ`) does NOT throw in `Intl` (probe confirmed), so it reaches `formatCurrency` and renders `ZZZ 1,234.50`, the same as the cell. The #9294 suite's `AMOUNT = 1234.5` is fractional, so its EUR `scale: 2` and no-code `scale: 2` rows stay green under the new arm (2 = EUR's minor unit = the no-currency width); consistent with the dev's A3 note.

- **(c) Which currency each face resolves.** One function: `resolveFieldCurrency` in `packages/i18n/src/currency.ts` (`field.currency || field.currencyConfig?.defaultCurrency || field.defaultCurrency || tenantDefault`), re-exported by `packages/fields/src/currency.ts`; footer imports it from `@object-ui/i18n`, cell from the fields re-export, tile from `@object-ui/i18n`. The footer's `columnHints` carry `type / currency / defaultCurrency / precision / scale` and NO `currencyConfig`, and the hook's `fieldMetadata` type has none either; that block is in no hunk of this PR (pre-existing at `1dbb9933c`). `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s configured-column cell bag copies `currency`, `precision`, `scale` only (three sites at base). The tile passes the whole `valueFieldDef`. Confirmed: the footer / grid-cell-bag drop of `currencyConfig.defaultCurrency` predates this PR, this PR does not worsen it (the `formatSummaryLabel` parameter type still accepts `currencyConfig`, so a hint fix is type-ready), and the dev's finding is correctly routed to a separate card since `ObjectGrid.tsx` is outside the surface. The pins declare currency through the field `currency` code and the tenant default, the two spellings all three faces read today.

- **(d) Dependency edges.** `@object-ui/fields: workspace:*` is already in `dependencies` of `packages/plugin-grid/package.json`, `packages/plugin-dashboard/package.json` and `packages/app-shell/package.json` at both `1dbb9933c` and the head; `git diff` on the three manifests is empty. The tile's other new import (`useDisplayLocale` from `@object-ui/i18n`) is likewise already declared. `scripts/check-phantom-dependencies.mjs` asks whether "the package that PUBLISHES this file declare[s] it" (bare specifiers vs the publishing package's manifest), so an undeclared import would fail it; here there is nothing to flag. `Pre-Install Import Graph Check` is success on the head.

- **(e) Designer.** `offersScale(type) = isNumeric(type) && type !== 'currency'` gates only the `Scale` control; `Precision`, `Min`, `Max` still render on currency; `number` and `percent` keep `Scale`. The `Precision` control is unchanged and writes `patchDef({ precision: v })`, the top-level field key, never `currencyConfig.precision` (the card's item-1 premise, pinned by the suite's last case; consistent with 乙 item 3's reading of field-level `precision` as a digit count). A stored currency draft carrying `scale` now has no control to clear it. Acceptable under the pin: the lockfile resolves `@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`, which accepts `scale` on a currency at parse (the sibling #10319 measured `FieldSchema.safeParse({ type: 'currency', scale: 0 })` succeeding), and no objectui display face reads it any more. Two notes for the seat, neither a defect of this PR: objectstack's objectql record validator still reads `scale` for currency until #19909 lands (server side, pre-existing); and when the pin bump that brings #19909 arrives, such drafts' saves will be refused with no on-screen remedy, so a type-conditional strip on the write path (objectui#4644 precedent) needs a card to carry it, exactly as the dev's acceptance note says.

- **(f) Changeset sentences vs code.** `.changeset/10221-currency-decimals-iso-minor-unit.md` (frontmatter `plugin-grid`, `plugin-dashboard`, `app-shell` at `minor`): every sentence checked TRUE. "each took the number of decimal places from the field's `scale`, with none when `scale` was absent" (base `column?.scale ?? 0`, `valueFieldDef.scale ?? 0`); "The currency list cell never read `scale`" (`CurrencyCellRenderer` calls `resolveFieldCurrency` + `formatCurrency` only); the `$1,235` / `¥1,234.5000` examples (probe rows above); "format ... with `formatCurrency` from `@object-ui/fields`, the list cell's own formatter" (both faces, with a code resolved); "two decimals for USD or CNY, none for JPY, three for KWD" (`currencyFractionDigits` via ICU `resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits`, probe: 2/2/0/3); "A whole amount shows no fraction (`$1,234`), as the cell does"; "When no currency resolves, ... plain number with two decimals, or none when it is whole" (footer via `formatNumber`, tile via the `'0,0'` / `'0,0.00'` pattern); "Neither `scale` nor `precision` is read on a currency"; "keeps its existing tenant-locale fallback for a currency code `Intl` does not accept" (true at head via `intlAcceptsCurrency`; ⚠️ this is the line the census refuses, see ③, so re-check the sentence after the remedy); "authored `format` pattern still renders that pattern"; the designer paragraph; the three "Behaviour change" bullets (probe rows JPY `scale: 2`, USD no `scale`, whole USD `scale: 2`); "Percent columns and fields still take their width from `scale`"; the migration paragraph. `.changeset/grid-summary-footer-tenant-locale-9294.md` and `.changeset/9295-percent-surfaces-read-scale.md`: the corrected paragraphs are true (the currency arm "kept reading" `scale` when those cards landed and #10221 "later moves" it; the percent arm's "matching the currency arm" clause is rightly dropped); the diff touches no frontmatter line (`plugin-grid: minor` and `fields / plugin-grid / plugin-detail: minor` unchanged); `check-changeset-overwrite` names "prose that no longer matches the change" as its legitimate case 2. The two changesets' rule agrees with #10319's changeset wording ("two decimals for USD or CNY, none for JPY, three for KWD"); the one declared difference is the wholeness switch (see (a)).

- **(g) Pins real and able to fail.** Test arithmetic reproduced from the head sources: footer suite 29 (18 currency × scale × wholeness agreement rows + 2 tenant-default + 2 no-code + 1 de-DE, 5 absolute-byte rows, 1 percent control), tile suite 29 (24 agreement incl. numeric-string, 4 absolute, 1 authored-format control), inspector suite 5, `useColumnSummary.test.tsx` 9 (one case rewritten from "honours a currency column scale" to the ruled member): 72 total. Base-tree directions from the base arm: footer 20 RED / 9 GREEN, tile 20 RED / 9 GREEN, inspector 2 RED / 3 GREEN, rewritten case 1 RED / 8 GREEN = 43 RED / 29 GREEN, matching the report's `43 failed | 29 passed (72)` exactly. The agreement rows render the REAL `CurrencyCellRenderer` under the same providers in the same run (they cannot pass by restating the rule); the absolute-byte rows guard a joint move; the percent and authored-format controls guard overshoot.
